MCUBOOT_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install mcuboot. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

MCUBOOT_VERSION.description: Specific version of mcuboot to install.

MCUBOOT_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading mcuboot binary or archive artifacts.

MCUBOOT_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying mcuboot available remote releases.

MCUBOOT_KEY_TYPE.description: Cryptographic key algorithm used by imgtool firmware signing (rsa-2048, rsa-3072, ecdsa-p256, ed25519).

MCUBOOT_KEY_FILE.description: Optional PEM signing key path managed via traits/secrets for deterministic firmware signing.

MCUBOOT_SLOT_SIZE.description: Hexadecimal or byte flash partition slot size passed to imgtool sign --slot-size.

MCUBOOT_HEADER_SIZE.description: MCUboot image header byte offset passed to imgtool sign --header-size.
